title: Witness Ed tests reverse-engineered vehicles

tellings.quote: So he said in 2000 1998 to 2002 this guy Ed um was briefed into programs that while he was at Nellis under the 98th Range Wing

plain: A witness known only as Ed is said to have been let into secret programmes from 1998 to 2002 while serving at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, in the 98th Range Wing, the unit that runs its testing ranges, and to have worked with vehicles built by copying non-human craft, with links to Edwards Air Force Base and Area 51. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this, passing on Ed's account as it came through the UFO activist Steven Greer, who collects such testimony. If true, it would mean the US military was flight-testing such craft around the turn of the century.
